newsitem.title: JAPAN: Glaxo Wellcome to take full control of Japan unit.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo Wellcome to take full control of Japan unit.

text.p: Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Thursday that it had reached an agreement with its joint venture partner Shin Nihon Jitsugyo Co Ltd for Glaxo Wellcome to take 100 percent control of the venture for a payment of 66 billion yen.
The venture, called Nippon Glaxo, develops, produces and markets prescription medicines in Japan.
Shin Nihon will receive 1.38 billion yen in lieu of dividends for 1996, Glaxo Wellcome said in a statement.
The net assets of the venture on June 30, 1996, were valued at 30.7 billion yen. The venture's post-tax profits for the six months to June 30, 1996, were 2.5 billion yen.
Glaxo Wellcome said the payments will be financed through borrowings in Japan. The acquisition is expected to help the group's earnings, Glaxo Wellcome said.
